task_name: Brief-only notebook/data breadth beyond whole-product competitors
task: Research the full notebook brief from scratch, including implementation opportunities outside whole-product competitors. Treatment protects breadth and optional leads while maintaining required-plan coverage.
question: Use brief-only cases in two domains where relevant components exist outside obvious whole-product competitors. Do not supply the target repositories or a list of answers.
source_scope: BRIEF_ONLY public live primary-source discovery; candidate selects components, no named target repository or semantic fixture.
control: Ordinary whole-product competitor and relevant-project research at the same source/time allowance.
treatment: Protect a share of discovery effort for different mechanism families, user promises and non-competitor components before deepening the best leads. Keep an explicit opportunity/alternative lane as well as defect hunting.
measure: Verified useful novelty, distinct mechanism coverage, applicability, false opportunities, required-plan coverage and cost; raw link counts are not quality.
integration_limit: This must run actual external discovery, not only a fixed normative corpus. Keep broad leads even if optional adoption is deferred.
family_binding_rule: Within pair identical actual supported family/model/effort. Root may version an unstarted card prospectively if route unavailable; preserve original planned family and reason. No substitution attributed as same-model replication.

execution_policy.factor_enforcement: V01 control critic physically lacks execution, not only text prohibition; otherwise tools equal unless documented factor is retrieval ordering/representation.

important_checks.question: Do the same predeclared consequential source/behavior claims receive correct supported correction or preservation under this method, without a new consequential error?
Does the final retain supported conditions, legitimate uncertainty and required useful content rather than blanket rejection or incomplete delivery?
Was the declared mechanism actually taken up with honest source/execution scope, and what critical/false-rejection/repair differences appear under matched budgets?

candidate_authorship: All substantive scored candidate checking, integration and code remain affordable candidate-native Goal work; Sol only scenario/protocol/evaluator infrastructure.
